name: samarth-early-warning
description: Frontend prototype for "Samarth Early Warning": an early-warning system for seniors living at home. It combines vitals, medicine records and call notes into a daily risk score compared with each senior's own baseline—not a population average. The interface is built to make the alert understandable and route it to a human; it does not diagnose. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No build step, no dependencies.

scripts.test: node --check server.js && node --check js/data.js && node --check js/views.js && node --check js/app.js && node --check test-backend.js
